title: Design System: Corinto Vivo · El Atrio Restaurado

scripture.purpose: Bible text, Paul's voice, and preserved reflection.

shadows.name: contact
shadows.purpose: Ground an interactive material piece at rest.

components.name: Primary World Action
components.description: The one dominant next action in a focused study viewport.
components.css: .ds-world-action{width:100%;min-height:48px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:14px 18px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--clay) 72%,transparent);border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:var(--material-terracotta),var(--clay);color:var(--clay-ink);font:600 1rem/1.2 var(--ui);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:inset 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.16),inset -2px -3px 3px rgba(89,29,19,.36),0 4px 0 rgba(95,34,23,.48);transition:filter 180ms var(--ease-out),transform 120ms var(--ease-out)}.ds-world-action span,.ds-world-action small{display:block}.ds-world-action small{margin-bottom:2px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:550;opacity:.78}.ds-world-action .ds-icon{width:20px;height:20px}.ds-world-action:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-world-action:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--clay-hi) 75%,white);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Depth Choice
components.description: One of three equally valid ways to enter a lesson.
components.css: .ds-depth-choice{min-height:64px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--ui);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 180ms var(--ease-out),background 180ms var(--ease-out),transform 120ms var(--ease-out)}.ds-depth-choice span,.ds-depth-choice small{display:block}.ds-depth-choice span{font-size:.94rem;font-weight:600}.ds-depth-choice small{margin-top:3px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.73rem;line-height:1.25}.ds-depth-choice[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--clay);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--clay) 10%,var(--surface-2))}.ds-depth-choice:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-depth-choice:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--clay) 68%,white);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Destination Dock
components.description: The durable Hoy, Mosaico, and Sábado destination model.
components.html: HoyMosaicoSábado
components.css: .ds-dock{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px;padding:6px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(rgba(13,15,18,.84),rgba(13,15,18,.84)),var(--material-basalt),var(--bg-0);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.07);font-family:var(--ui)}.ds-dock a{min-height:44px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);color:var(--muted);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;transition:color 160ms var(--ease-out),background 160ms var(--ease-out)}.ds-dock a[aria-current="page"]{box-shadow:inset 0 2px 0 var(--clay);color:var(--clay)}.ds-dock a:hover{color:var(--text)}.ds-dock a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--clay);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Persistent Lesson Relief
components.description: The locally stored, responsive lesson bas-relief that remains mounted across the primary journey and visibly restores through five stages.

components.name: Quarter Mosaic Panel
components.description: One durable lesson state embedded in the quarter artifact.
components.css: .ds-quarter-panel{position:relative;min-height:190px;display:grid;padding:7px;border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:var(--material-grout),var(--surface-2);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) 3%,transparent),var(--shadow);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--ui);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;transition:transform 280ms var(--ease-out),border-color 180ms var(--ease-out),box-shadow 280ms var(--ease-out)}.ds-quarter-panel img{position:absolute;inset:7px;width:calc(100% - 14px);height:calc(100% - 14px);object-fit:cover;filter:saturate(.3) brightness(.62)}.ds-quarter-panel__number,.ds-quarter-panel__copy{position:relative;z-index:1}.ds-quarter-panel__number{align-self:start;justify-self:start;padding:4px 6px;background:var(--bg-0);color:var(--clay);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em}.ds-quarter-panel__copy{align-self:end;display:grid;gap:3px;padding:30px 8px 8px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(8,10,13,.94) 55%)}.ds-quarter-panel__copy strong{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.15}.ds-quarter-panel__copy span{color:var(--text-soft);font-size:.72rem}.ds-quarter-panel:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--clay);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}.ds-quarter-panel:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--clay-hi);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Sabbath Folio Field
components.description: An editable weekly synthesis field with explicit share selection.
components.css: .ds-folio-field{display:grid;gap:8px;padding:18px;border-left:2px solid var(--clay);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--ui)}.ds-folio-field>span:first-child{font-size:.74rem;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-folio-field textarea{min-height:112px;padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text);font:400 1rem/1.5 var(--ui);resize:vertical;transition:border-color 160ms var(--ease-out),box-shadow 160ms var(--ease-out)}.ds-folio-field textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--clay);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--clay) 20%,transparent)}.ds-folio-field__choice{min-height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--text-soft);font-size:.86rem}.ds-folio-field__choice input{width:20px;height:20px;accent-color:var(--clay)}

narrative.overview:
The learner inhabits one Corinthian restoration courtyard rather than scrolling through a stack of devotional cards. Each honest response restores a visible part of a persistent lesson relief, sets a tessera, or returns as an inscription, commitment, capability, or cross-week join.

The interface is reverent, tactile, authored, and quietly dramatic. Local raster relief and material textures carry believable depth; semantic HTML owns all copy and controls; CSS owns architecture, light, and stage masks; SVG remains a graceful fallback. The result feels like entering an evolving place rather than opening another Bible study app.
keyCharacteristics: One persistent quarter artifact, not thirteen disconnected progress cards.
Thirteen lesson-specific local reliefs with responsive 320, 640, and 1024 pixel sources.
Semantic DOM owns every word, control, focus state, and user investment.
CSS clip paths reveal five restoration stages; SVG remains a loading and failure fallback.
Open editorial composition with structural stone and paper surfaces.
One clay accent and one physically credible light source per scene.
Strong causal transformations followed by a quiet resting state.
Saved language, commitments, skills, and connections return later.
No points, ranks, loss-aversion streaks, or spiritual-performance scoring.

rules.name: The Artifact Is the Reward Rule
rules.body: Ordinary completion changes the persistent mosaic inline. It does not trigger a generic reward modal or confetti.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Spectacle Rule
rules.body: Motion and illustration may amplify a real learning consequence, but they never substitute for one.

rules.name: The One Clay Voice Rule
rules.body: Clay is the only brand accent. Supporting state colors communicate status and never become a second decorative palette.

rules.name: The Credible Light Rule
rules.body: Glow belongs to fire, dawn, a restored join, or a newly placed piece. Never put a radial halo behind an object merely to make it look important.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Outfit is the learner and the interface. EB Garamond is Scripture, Paul, or a preserved contemplative voice. Serif is never a generic badge of spirituality.

rules.name: The Whole Phrase Rule
rules.body: Kinetic type splits by meaningful phrase or line and preserves one complete accessible string. Scripture is never animated character by character.

rules.name: The One Main Action Rule
rules.body: Every focused viewport has one primary next action. Secondary exits remain honest and visible but subordinate.

rules.name: The Object Continuity Rule
rules.body: Moving among Hoy, Mosaico, a lesson, and Sábado should preserve the sense that the same panel is being approached, worked, and returned.

rules.name: The Grounded by Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces begin embedded in the composition. Lift is a state change, not the default treatment of every section.

rules.name: The Local Grain Rule
rules.body: Texture belongs to stone, clay, paper, or grout. It never becomes a full-screen noise veil over text.

rules.name: The Silhouette First Rule
rules.body: A narrative object must read at flat silhouette before shading, texture, glow, or motion is added.

dos: Do make the persistent artifact both navigation and reward.
Do show one immediate next action and an honest way to stop.
Do return prior language, commitments, capabilities, and cross-week connections with clear context.
Do keep focus, landmarks, live-region feedback, and keyboard operation intact through transitions.
Do preserve local-first privacy and make sharing an explicit selection.
Do use authored asymmetry, localized texture, and one coherent physical light source.
Do verify every responsive relief, crop, stage, and fallback in Chromium and WebKit at compact, mobile, and hero sizes.
donts: Don't build another centered card stack, bento grid, or collection of rounded devotional tiles.
Don't use points, ranks, loss-aversion streaks, variable loot, or spiritual-performance status.
Don't use the same modal, confetti, or generic radial glow after every answer.
Don't add WebGL, CDN scripts, or an animation library without a demonstrated product gap.
Don't animate Scripture per character or make controls wait for choreography.
Don't expose another person's information without explicit consent.
Don't hand-edit generated lesson modules or break their verified eight-station semantics.
Don't encode completion, connection, or selection by clay color alone.
